feed.title: Delta Signal ATLAS-7 Changelog
feed.subtitle: Public changelog for Delta Signal ATLAS-7 MCP, OpenAPI, x402, notification, SPECTRA, and evidence-contract changes.

entry.title: SPECTRA generation model documented
entry.summary: The public docs now explain SPECTRA as the field-map contract layer derived from ATLAS-history-shaped rows: ticker/source-date resolution, numeric/date/boolean normalization, pressure and range labels, provenance, caveats, and structured soft-miss behavior. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > SPECTRA generation model documented Track: T+1050m Commit: current changelog update

entry.title: ATLAS-7 generation model documented
entry.summary: The public docs now explain ATLAS-7 as the generated issuer evidence layer: EDGAR CompanyFacts mirror or reconstruction, process-changes deltas, crypto-exposed issuer matching, ticker/CIK normalization, dated evidence rows, calculation history, and MCP-safe evidence outputs. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > ATLAS-7 generation model documented Track: T+1042m Commit: current changelog update

entry.title: EDGAR trading-week audit and 2026-06-02 reconciliation
entry.summary: The June 1-5 trading-week audit is now complete: all five business dates have CompanyFacts ZIP coverage, delta summaries, digital-assets delta artifacts, and recorded status, with 2026-06-02 classified as recovered_reconciled after daily-feed reconstruction. entry.title: CompanyFacts daily-feed reconstruction restore path
entry.summary: The recovery log now documents the fallback used when SEC companyfacts.zip does not advance for a business date: if full-index, daily-feed, and prior baseline artifacts exist, the worker reconstructs the missing CompanyFacts ZIP from the daily feed, validates it, and records reconciliation policy before promotion. Breadcrumb: Improvement Timeline > CompanyFacts daily-feed reconstruction restore path Track: T+1026m Commit: current changelog update
